clips.scope:
One owned standalone PIE: visible initial arrival, then genuine team Pickaxe pressure.

No package saves, network peers, damage/state/counter trigger helpers, or forged
counter timing. Natural initial loading/perk barriers stay active. The combat
fixture adds one non-player striker, sufficient shield durability and blocked
ordinary ability cooldowns; every counted hit uses SetPrimaryInputHeld.
limitations: One standalone PIE; an extra authority-only striker is a disclosed actor fixture, not a second network player.
Initial pawn spawn, loading cover, first perk completion and arrival movement use their normal gameplay paths.
The first mandatory perk is selected normally through ChooseRewardPerk(0); the world is not forcibly unpaused.
Combat fixture uses high shield durability to survive 10–12 real Pickaxe contacts and suppresses unrelated normal ability readiness.
Combat actors are positioned once; no position/movement correction is applied after the counter starts.
The private arrival-held flag is not exposed to Python: the hold/release observation uses public CharacterMovement MovementMode None -> Falling/Walking, supported height and unchanged health/reserve.
True game-window PNGs include the unchanged HUD; this is not a full encounter balance playthrough.

clips.scope:
Disclosed completed-portion fixture followed by the real native stage chest.

Owns one standalone L_Mouth PIE. Loading and first personal perk proceed
normally. After actual first food arrives, only the portion's completion
fixture is prepared: issued=target=3, ordinary food/surface actors removed,
arena tooth coffee zeroed. Native Director tick creates/initializes its reward.
No reward pending, completion ledger, chest stage, loot or claimed fields are
written. The observer is placed once on traced tongue support outside opening
range, then approaches with AddMovementInput. A temporary review camera and
normal ChooseRewardPerk callback expose the actual UI and immediate Grenade.
No network, packaged-game, all-event, held-food or death validation is claimed.
limitations: One standalone authority PIE, silent frames; no multiplayer or packaged game verification.
Completion of the first 3-item portion is a disclosed fixture; this is not a complete food/cleaning playthrough.
The chest is created by the actual Director tick; its pending/ledger/stage/loot/claim state is never written.
One supported observer placement and one review camera are fixtures. Approach uses ordinary AddMovementInput.
Selection and one duplicate request use real PlayerController callbacks/RPCs, not physical mouse input.
A solo recipient cannot establish replicated team-wide effect. Native focused tests cover multi-recipient logic.
Held-food preservation and death are not exercised in this zero-food completion fixture.
No asset, map, profile or user settings are saved; warm loading observations are not asserted as cold-cache coverage.

clips.scope:
Short, owned solo check of saved settings/Voice UMG, without audio capture.

Run after the approved build and author_voice_ui.py, through RunOwnedEditor.ps1.
Reuses the existing settings check and its preference/graphics/editor restoration.
Never opens a microphone, starts a mic test, connects peers or sends voice. Actual
runtime window frames are captured separately from explicitly labelled Designer
indicator examples. Optional MC_VOICE_UI_OUTPUT environment variable selects a
fresh output directory on E:.
limitations: Local solo PIE; no packaged game or multiplayer.
Normal callbacks/control setters are used; physical input is not injected.
Audio routing/gains are checked; this silent capture is not a listening test.
Display resolution and mode are kept unchanged; rollback is covered by native tests.
Mic test/device-settings buttons are inspected but never clicked; no microphone stream is opened.
Rebind starts via the actual button and cancels through normal menu StopInteraction. Physical key delivery/new-key acceptance is outside this Python check.
Voice gain independence checks preference/routing math; a silent solo run cannot verify remote playback.
Indicator animation PNGs are labelled Designer examples, not real talker audio. Runtime only checks the real inactive state; no fake talking flag is set.
The MainMenu map may have no character/indicator component. Absence is reported, not a gameplay assertion.
